How This American Life connects

  • Character: Ira Glass — Ira Glass hosts This American Life.
  • Topic: Serial — This American Life incubated and first distributed Serial.
  • Faction: WBEZ — WBEZ was the longtime station home of This American Life.
  • Concept: true-crime podcast form — This American Life's reported-essay style shaped Serial's true-crime form.

What is This American Life?

This American Life is the WBEZ-born weekly program whose reported-essay form, Ira Glass hosting, and 2014 preview episode launched Serial as a spin-off rather than a one-off story.

Key threads lead to Ira Glass, Serial, WBEZ and true-crime podcast form.
